units.source_text: 倘使莱纳德夫人的管理人富伊依达是个印度少女，

en.t: If Mrs. Leonard's steward Fuyiyida had been an Indian girl,

units.source_text: 那么莱蒙特叙述他在天界会见基督时高兴得发抖，为什么却没有看见释迦牟尼世尊呢？

en.t: then why, when Lamont described trembling with joy as he met Christ in heaven, did he not see the World-Honored Shakyamuni?

units.source_text: 为什么没有阐述佛典教导的那个世界丰富的幻想呢？

en.t: Why did he not set forth the rich visions of that world taught in the Buddhist scriptures?
